Below are the three patches needed to surface the emulated screen dimensions and deviceScaleFactor in the “devices” tooltip.  We

1. Extend `Util.getEmulationDescriptions()` to pull `screenEmulation` (width/height) and `deviceScaleFactor` out of `configSettings.screenEmulation` and return them on `envValues`.
2. Add two new UIStrings in `report/renderer/util.js` for our new labels.
3. Update the “devices” entry in `report/renderer/report-renderer.js` to include those two new values in the tooltip.
